checks_executed.name: render a name holding the separator

checks_executed.command: PYTHONPATH=src /usr/bin/python3 -c 'from signpost.render import WIDTH,row; n=row("Fork Ridge",4).split("|")[0]; print(len(n), WIDTH)'
checks_executed.name: measure the rendered name field

findings.claim: join() concatenates the fields with a bare separator, so a field holding the separator becomes two fields
findings.scenario: run PYTHONPATH=src /usr/bin/python3 -m signpost.render 'Fork|Ridge' 4; the row prints `Fork|Ridge  |4` and the count line reads columns=3

notes: The padder reads as an off-by-one on its own; running it through render.row shows the caller passes WIDTH + 1 and the field measures 12. That one is kept as a note.

notes_kept.claim: pad() subtracts one from the width it is given
notes_kept.scenario: render.row calls pad(name, WIDTH + 1), so the rendered name field measures 12 characters; the measurement above prints `12 12`
